notes.ridgeway-complex: The Ridgeway Complex is the seven halls OSM names Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Kappa, Omega and Sigma around Ridgeway Commons (WWU campus directory codes RA-RS, RC); pinned at Ridgeway Commons (OSM way/367881277) in the middle of them.
notes.fairhaven-complex: The Fairhaven Complex (WWU campus directory code FX) is the twelve Fairhaven Stacks OSM maps as 'Fairhaven Stack 1' to '11/12' (ways 224997056-224997067); pinned at Stack 5 in the middle of them.
notes.FA: FA 'Fairhaven Academic Building / Fairhaven College' on the directory list is OSM's 'Fairhaven College of Interdisciplinary Studies' (way/224996902), which the name rules missed.
notes.commissary: The Commissary (CM) is dining services' central kitchen and warehouse, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.physical-plant: The Physical Plant (PP) is the facilities building, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.campus-services: Campus Services (CS) holds facilities, mail and parking offices, not classes.
notes.alumni-house: The Alumni House (AL) is an office, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.edens-hall-north: Edens Hall North (EN) is a residence hall (wwu.edu/housing), not a class building.

detours.why: Ridgeway sits on the ridge above the science buildings: the mapped paths leave the complex at its south end and follow the Wade King service road below it, and the Interdisciplinary Science Building's mapped door is on its north-east side, so the walk comes round the building.
